_: A rival King beyond the realm (rivals.js; CK3's and Crusader Kings' neighbouring realms, Total War's border probes): one, dealt by the reign's seed from kings, with the edge of the realm he lies beyond and his hostility (0 friend .. 100 at war in all but name, starting at start). It drifts toward rest by drift a season. Each season he may probe the border: with chance raid x hostility/100 his riders raid the realm's town nearest his edge (Freeciv's own raiders, the chronicle names whose they are). His envoys come as event cards (cards, in events.js's shape, drawn with the realm's; when.rival {above, below}: his hostility; a choice's effects rival: how it moves him; text may say {foreign} and {foreignking}).

cards.subject: seat
cards.title: An envoy from {foreign}
cards.text: {foreignking}'s envoy bows no lower than he must. "My master asks a gift of friendship from the crown of the realm, Your Grace. A hundred in gold, and his riders stay home."

choices.label: Pay the gift
text: The gold goes south with the envoy. The lords say nothing to the King's face.
The envoy rides home heavier. At court, the lords look at their boots.

choices.label: Send him home with nothing
text: The envoy leaves with empty hands and a stiff back. The lords like it.
No gold for {foreign}. The envoy rides off without a word, and the hall cheers.

choices.label: Send back his beard in a box
text: The envoy goes home shaved. {foreignking} will not forget it, and neither will the lords, who laugh about it for a year.

ignore.text: The envoy from {foreign} waits a season for an answer and goes home without one.

cards.subject: seat
cards.title: {foreignking} offers a match
cards.text: A letter under {foreign}'s seal: {foreignking} offers a child of the blood to wed the crown's heir. Peace on the border for as long as the marriage lasts.

choices.label: Accept the match
text: The match is sealed. The border goes quiet, and the great houses mutter that the heir's hand went abroad.

choices.label: Decline, politely
text: The crown declines with fine words. {foreignking} reads them twice.

cards.subject: seat
cards.title: A ford on the border
cards.text: Men of {foreign} have set a toll on the ford our drovers have always used. Our side of the river, they say, was always theirs.

choices.label: Let them have it
text: The drovers pay {foreign}'s toll and curse the King under their breath.

choices.label: Send men to hold the ford
text: Royal spearmen stand at the ford. {foreign}'s tollmen go back across the water.

ignore.text: Nobody holds the ford, so {foreign} does.

cards.subject: crown_town
cards.title: A spy at {town}
cards.text: The reeve of {town} has a man in the cellar who speaks with {foreign}'s accent and carried a map of the walls.

choices.label: Hang him
text: The spy hangs in {town}'s square. {foreignking} sends no one to claim the body.

choices.label: Send him home
text: The spy is put on a mule and sent home. {foreign} takes note of the courtesy.

choices.label: Pay him to lie to his master
text: The spy goes home with our gold and a false map. {foreignking} will build his plans on it.

ignore.text: The spy at {town} slips his ropes one night, and is gone.
